turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz city council will pay its year-end bonus without borrowing any money, Palabra BCS reported on November 10. The city is covering wages and benefits for December from its own funds.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mayor Milena Quiroga said the MXN 71.5 million payment comes from city revenue alone.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Property-tax collections arrived early this year.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: With a 30 percent discount offered to residents.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? So the bonus goes out on November 12.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: No bank loans and no state loans are involved at all.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I wonder what that means for their urban development spending.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It keeps options open for investments in housing and roads without debt. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: This matters for Baja California Sur because balanced local budgets shape what cities can actually build next, from roads to housing.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's metric lists 776 housing registrations under the SNIIV system for the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: You are listening to Radio BCS2050. Today's deep dive is on Urbanism.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Our reporting will answer how local finances are lining up with the housing and road plans now on the table. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is the concrete question we follow from here, and what it means for everyday services across the state.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS reported on November 10 that La Paz city council will not borrow money for its year-end payments.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They plan to bring forward the MXN 71.5 million bonus instead.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mayor Milena Quiroga said the funds come from the city's own revenue.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Early payments of 2027 property taxes with a 30 percent discount helped.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The bonus goes out on November 12 without any bank loans. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What does skipping new debt mean for services residents use every day?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It keeps the budget steady so payroll and basic operations stay on track without extra interest costs.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same week HCN reported that Los Cabos council approved a public consultation on the El Tezal plan.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: IMPLAN will publish the updated partial urban development plan for Cabo San Lucas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: People can comment on zoning, land use and future growth.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The council gave unanimous approval on November 6.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: IMPLAN will announce venues, dates and participation channels soon.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Where will residents actually go to see the maps and submit comments?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That timing matters because the 2025 update was never published in the Official Bulletin.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meganoticias covered private-sector concerns about exactly that gap on October 29.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Eduardo Sánchez Navarro from Grupo Questro asked for density limits and better infrastructure.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: He also wants protection for beach access along the East Cape road.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The plan needs to move fast but stay technically sound. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How does an unfinished plan affect builders and families already living in those zones?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Without clear rules, projects can stall or grow without enough roads and water lines.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Sánchez Navarro wants the new version to fix those missing pieces before approval.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The consultation on El Tezal is the first formal step toward that fix.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents in Cabo San Lucas now have a short window to shape what gets built next.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: One surprise is how quickly the council moved to open comments after the earlier delay.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep wondering which neighborhoods will see the biggest changes first.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The answers will come once the venues and dates are posted. [laugh]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Quepoca reported that Fuerza por México BCS held an assembly on November 8 in La Paz.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They discussed a possible alliance with PAN ahead of the 2027 elections.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: New leaders from Cabo San Lucas joined during that meeting.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Urban plans like El Tezal could shape what those coalitions debate next year.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Really? The timing lines up with the public comments opening now.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS reported on 10 November that La Paz city council will pay its year-end bonus without new loans.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mayor Milena Quiroga said the 71.5 million pesos will come from own revenue.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Early property-tax payments at a 30 percent discount helped the timing.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That approach avoids any bank borrowing right before December.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The payment itself was moved forward to 12 November.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That shows La Paz has some fiscal room right now. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz lists 292241 residents across its territory.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Its cabecera alone holds 250141 people.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The 2026 revenue law projects 2905974532 pesos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mm. That figure sets the scale for what services the city can fund locally.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos is larger still, with 351111 people.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It also carries the highest relative fiscal capacity among the five municipalities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos runs the main international airport and hospitality cluster.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That revenue base supports the south but still faces aquifer deficits in 0317 and 0319.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Comondú has 73021 residents and focuses on the Valle Santo Domingo agricultural pole.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Its 2026 revenue projection sits at 817244119 pesos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mulegé lists 64022 people, with Santa Rosalía as cabecera.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It has no public cadastre viewer and its PMDU remains in the consultative stage. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto is the smallest at 18052 residents and keeps its 2014 POEL in force.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Its 2024 plan update is still under consultation.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: These population and revenue figures shape what each place can actually build or maintain.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos and La Paz carry the biggest service loads, while the northern and central municipalities face greater sparsity.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same sources note aquifer deficits in Los Cabos, La Paz and Comondú areas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That directly limits how much new urban growth those municipalities can support without new infrastructure.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Quepoca covered an 8 November assembly in La Paz where Fuerza por México discussed possible alliances ahead of 2027.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The party also announced new leaders joining from Cabo San Lucas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Local leadership decisions like these will decide who sets the next urban priorities.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The practical question is whether the current revenue base can keep pace with the documented service gaps. [laugh]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Act 2 · The hidden thread starts with the 50 property titles Governor Víctor Castro delivered in Los Frailes.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: HCN reported those titles went to families under the relocation programme on 17 November.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state spent 6.4 million pesos on the titles plus nine starter homes.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That brings the five-year total in Mulegé to 992 housing actions.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Worth 145.4 million pesos according to the state housing institute.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Diario Humano says Los Cabos residents start collecting signatures this week for the coastal road.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They want the East Cape Coastal Road kept as a rustic scenic drive in the 2040 plan.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Instead of the highway Grupo Questro proposed one kilometre inland.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That plan must now line up with the POERBCS ecological ordinance decreed in January.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: POERBCS sets the state UGAs and serves as the ceiling over every municipal PDU.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meganoticias reported the first 704 homes in Sierra Vista are already over 90 percent built.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those homes will move families out of stream beds in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The mayor there noted land and drinking water remain the main obstacles.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: In La Paz the council approved two new buses for the Tiburón Urbano route to El Centenario.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents had asked for the link because public transport stays scarce there.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: But here's the thing the earlier Foresight editions flagged water and social housing reopening the territorial debate.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal noted Los Cabos ranks last in water investment while its engine loses pace.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: At the Foro Mar de Cortés summit leaders signed an agreement for a Sea of Cortez Citizen Observatory.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It will include a traffic-light index for biodiversity and illegal fishing.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same week high tides flooded over 300 homes in Puerto San Carlos after the berm collapsed.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Governor Castro linked those tides reaching new places to climate change and El Niño.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The hidden requirement is that every local plan must now cohere with POERBCS and the DMA deficit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The surprise turn is that the ecological ordinance was meant to set the ceiling.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet repeated flooding and water shortfalls are forcing the plans to bend upward instead.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That tension will decide whether the 2040 plan keeps the road or changes the housing sites. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Did you know that in 2025 BCS recorded financing for 8,993 housing actions.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is a large number. What exactly counts as one housing action?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It can mean a new mortgage, a subsidy, or support to build or buy one home. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the total covers thousands of individual households across the state.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Yes. The same data set shows only 776 new housing registrations that year.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The gap between the money approved and the homes actually registered stands out.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It does. The portal also lists a six-year target of 37,500 housing actions.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That target comes from the convenio signed in October 2024 for Vivienda para el Bienestar.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It covers the whole state. Urban plans must guide where those homes can go.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos still works under its PDU 2040 approved in 2013.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz follows its own plan from 2018. Both documents remain vigente.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: A third update for Los Cabos was called in 2023, yet the 2013 rules still apply.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: New financing therefore has to fit inside older planning lines.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same challenge appears in smaller cities. Ciudad Constitución recorded 43,805 residents in 2020.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That figure is only for the head town of Comondú, not the full municipality.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the housing numbers affect both the big tourism centers and places like Comondú.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They do. The open question is how the 2025 financing line will align with the older plans and the larger target.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It will shape where new homes actually appear in the coming years.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meanwhile state population stood at 798,447 back in the 2020 census.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That growth pressure makes the housing gap even more noticeable across municipalities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly. And 22 of 39 aquifers already sit in deficit according to CONAGUA data from 2023.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So any new homes will also need to line up with water limits that planners already track.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal leaves that alignment as the key uncertainty for the years ahead. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Regional Ecological Ordinance for Baja California Sur, known as POERBCS, was decreed in January 2026.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That recent?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Gringo Gazette reports the decree sets 56 state-level UGAs across the territory.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: 56. That is a lot to track at once.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: SEPUIMM leads the ordinance as the ceiling rule over any municipal land-use plan.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So nothing at the city level can override it.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That means every PDU, like the one for Los Cabos 2040, must stay under those UGA policies.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mm. And the capital plan has its own version too.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The CEPAL document from 2001 explains ordenamiento territorial as the core instrument for coordinating urban and regional policy in Latin America.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So when a developer wants to change land use, the first check is against the POERBCS Aprovechamiento Sustentable or Preservación categories.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly. The categories set the first filter.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: IMPLAN in Los Cabos then applies the local PDU under that state ceiling.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The knowledge graph lists five deferencias urbanas from the planning guide that further shape those decisions.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Five specific ones. They must be checked before anything moves forward.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One everyday object that shows the system is a new water meter connection request.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Before the meter is approved, the package checks DMA capacity, aquifer status, and whether the site sits inside an ANP.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The viability package also reviews energy from SIBCS and CFE against the PRODESEN plan.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: If the project includes a desaladora or industrial park, the same layers apply.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The ontology calls this the dq_viabilidad_proyecto set of coupled factors.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Atlas of Urban Expansion from 2016 gives benchmark densities that planners here can compare against.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Planet of Cities from 2012 adds the global pattern data that informs the BCS growth scenarios.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The hidden part is that none of these checks appear on the building permit itself.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They sit in the POERBCS maps and the risk layers from CENAPRED and the state atlas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the next time you see a new road or hotel site posted, the question is which UGA it landed in. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And whether the political cycle will still line up with the next five-year review.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep wondering how the ejido lands fit into that timing. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state atlas already flags those overlaps as a standing risk.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal’s Tendencia 2050 describes Baja California Sur heading into a polycentric system rather than one coastal pattern repeated from south to north.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That reading comes from the demand–supply board and stays constrained at state scale.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos keeps the tourism engine role but sits under water and power stress.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape stays in tension with protected areas, while Todos Santos and El Pescadero form the Pacific amenity spine.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz serves as the service capital and water–energy node.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Loreto anchors tourism and conservation, while Comondú holds an agricultural hub with more room.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Northern Mulegé appears as a thinly documented corridor with a remote generation tender.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal’s Visión pillar on Housing flags the main risk of new units placed without services or inside coastal and water-risk zones.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state population stood at 798,447 in the INEGI Census 2020.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Housing news this period leans toward relief or progress.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The listed aspiration calls for housing that carries services and sits off the first line of risk.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It must also match real water and energy margins.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: No 2050 housing-unit target appears in the portal.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: No comparable series exists yet to set one.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The levers start with relocating what is already exposed before opening any new residential front on the coast or on aquifers in deficit.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Every development must cross-check against the demand–supply board and current planning instruments.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Backlog and lack of services count as a ceiling, not a gap the market will close by itself.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: For that polycentric picture to hold, each area keeps its distinct role.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: New tourism or residential growth occurs only where water and energy show evidenced margin or a non-DMA source such as desal.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It must avoid claiming NOM-011 credit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: East Cape and Loreto must respect ANP and POEL ceilings before scaling hospitality.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú and the north can add production and energy without emptying services or protected areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The watchlist opens with the 2027 budget package of 28.3 billion pesos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Approval is expected in December.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The fifth report was already delivered to Congress on 12 November.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: A public event is set for 27 November at Plaza de la Reforma in La Paz.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: El Tezal partial plan enters public consultation through IMPLAN Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Los Cabos urban plan update carries density limits plus the Cabo del Este coastal road question.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Housing for Wellbeing plot locations and the Social Housing Window will face checks against water and service capacity.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the next moves on those instruments will show whether the polycentric roles stay distinct or start to blur.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep thinking about how those checks play out in practice.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly. [chuckle] The details in the 2027 package will tell us a lot.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So this changes how the Los Cabos and La Paz councils approach new developments.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly. Responsibility for the urban plans rests with them.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents and the private sector have already called for density limits and protection of the East Cape coastal road in those plans.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The governor has delivered housing actions in Mulegé, and Los Cabos council has approved a public consultation on the El Tezal plan.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What we do not yet know is whether the new plans will meet the aspiration for services and risk avoidance in practice. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is the open question for Baja California Sur.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mm. I keep thinking about how the La Paz council's bus extension fits into the same picture of services.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It does. The councils carry the main responsibility here. [chuckle]
